baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from inward intent, to extending hands, to those same hands being restrained.
baseline_models.mechanism: The threat is intercepted at the threshold between resolved intention and effective reach. Repetition of the hands before and after restraint tracks one hostile capacity whose extension is stopped before the ayah narrates any completed injury.

activation_trace.role: Inwardly formed resolve supplies the pre-action stage of the threat.
Releasing or extending the hand turns resolve into outward reach.
The repeated hand contributes power and effective capacity, the channel targeted by restraint.
Prevention and repulsion close the hostile action channel.

changed_reading.before: God rescued the believers from an attack.
changed_reading.after: The remembered favor is preemptive interception: a formed hostile purpose loses effective reach before injury is narrated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Remember the favor, guard yourselves before God, and let the believers rely upon God.
baseline_models.mechanism: Deliberate recollection makes received protection present again, converts it into self-guarding conduct, and settles the heart into reliance. The repeated faith root frames the whole movement, so trust is the cultivated result of remembered protection rather than an unrelated closing maxim.

activation_trace.role: Recollection restores an event to active awareness rather than leaving it as past information.
The preserved good condition identifies the interrupted threat as benefaction.
Putting oneself in protection turns received safety into a present discipline.
Reliance locates ultimate efficacy with God after prudent self-guarding.
The opening and closing faith designations frame the desired result as secure, trusting composure.

changed_reading.before: The ayah asks for gratitude and then separately commands piety and trust.
changed_reading.after: Remembering protection is itself a formative practice: it produces guarded conduct and a secure reliance that answers the earlier threat.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope places remembering favor inside an obligation-and-covenant system. Fulfilled bonds and the pledge to hear and obey are opposed by forgetting what one was reminded of, whose social result is incited enmity and hatred. Memory in 5:11 therefore maintains covenantal restraint rather than merely preserving a private feeling of gratitude.

activation_trace.role: Active recollection is the focus mechanism that context turns into covenant maintenance.
A binding, ratified obligation establishes the pericope's opening social frame.
The confirmed covenant directly follows the repeated command to remember the favor.
Hearing as understanding and compliance makes remembrance answerable in conduct.
Obedient yielding supplies the behavioral content of the remembered pledge.
Loss of remembrance supplies the explicit failure mode opposite the focus command.
Incitement supplies the arrow by which failed remembrance becomes an enduring social force.
Repulsion opposed to love names the hardened relational outcome of forgetting.

structural_cues: 5:7 repeats the focus formula 'remember God's favor upon you' and immediately names the covenant and the response 'we hear and obey.'
5:13 and 5:14 repeat forgetting a share of what had been recalled; 5:14 then names enmity and hatred.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formula, covenant, obedience, forgetting, and resulting hostility; I infer that recollection is the maintenance operation that keeps a protected community covenantally restrained. A live alternative is that the repeated formulas introduce separate episodes without this causal linkage.

changed_reading.before: Remember the prevented assault as a reason for gratitude.
changed_reading.after: Rehearse the prevention as covenant memory: remembered favor sustains obedient restraint, while forgetting lets hostility become a durable social relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Commands surrounding the focus forbid hatred of a people from producing transgression or injustice. God's restraint of hostile hands thus becomes a pattern the protected believers must mirror: protection from another group's reach does not authorize their own retaliatory reach beyond the limit.

activation_trace.role: Divine prevention supplies the restraint whose ethical symmetry context activates.
Hatred and enmity provide the affective pressure under which restraint is tested.
Crossing the limit names the retaliatory extension the protected community must refuse.
Repeated just conduct supplies the positive form of self-restraint toward a hated people.

structural_cues: 5:2 and 5:8 both address believers, name hostility toward a people, and place taqwa beside commands not to transgress or abandon justice.
The focus repeats a hostile people and taqwa while narrating the stopping of their hands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine restraint plus explicit prohibitions on hate-driven excess; I add the normative arrow that recipients should reproduce restraint in their own conduct. The materially live alternative is that 5:11 only reports God's unilateral protection.

changed_reading.before: God restrained the enemies, so the believers are secure from them.
changed_reading.after: God's restraint also educates the protected: memory of being spared must prevent hatred from turning their own agency into transgression.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier material sequences regulate potentially harmful bodily agency: trained hunting instruments hold rather than merely tear, and believers' hands are washed within a purification said to complete favor. Against that sequence, the restrained hands in 5:11 can be read as another mode by which favor makes embodied power governable.

activation_trace.role: The bodily hands anchor the material analogy in the focus ayah.
Holding back supplies the focus mode of governing bodily force.
Trained hunting instruments contribute dangerous capacity placed under discipline.
Holding and confining contribute controlled capture rather than unbounded injury.
The twice-mentioned bodily hands become explicit objects of ritual regulation.
Purification by washing supplies a second mode of governing embodied agency.
Bringing favor to completion links bodily regulation back to the focus name for protection.

structural_cues: 5:4 joins trained hunting instruments, what they hold, remembrance, and taqwa.
5:6 mentions hands twice and says purification completes favor; 5:11 mentions hostile hands twice and calls their restraint favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated bodily vocabulary and favor formulas; I infer a cross-domain analogy in which training, holding, washing, and restraint govern dangerous capacity. The live alternative is that the legal-ritual and threat scenes are independent, making this resonance thematic rather than compositional.

changed_reading.before: The hands are only the enemies' weapons in one historical threat.
changed_reading.after: The hands join a wider material sequence in which favor does not erase agency but trains, cleans, holds, and limits its capacity to wound.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene repeats remembering favor and then repeats reliance upon God as two favored men command entry through a gate, with overcoming expected after entry. The opposing response is to remain sitting while assigning the fight elsewhere. This sequence distinguishes entrusting the outcome from abandoning one's assigned action.

activation_trace.role: Reliance is the focus disposition whose practical content the later scene tests.
The repeated benefaction formula begins the later trial of remembered favor.
Actual entry supplies the believer's required movement into the threatened space.
The gate makes trust a threshold-crossing act rather than an interior sentiment.
Overcoming is promised after entry, separating entrusted outcome from required action.
The near-verbatim reliance formula ties active entry back to the focus ending.
Abstention from action supplies the immediate counterfeit against which trust is defined.

structural_cues: 5:20 repeats 'remember God's favor upon you,' while 5:23 repeats reliance upon God and conditions it on being believers.
In 5:23 entry precedes promised overcoming; 5:24 answers with delegated fighting and sitting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated formulas and the entry-versus-sitting contrast; I infer that proper reliance delegates efficacy but not duty. A live alternative is that 5:11 emphasizes wholly unilateral protection and need not prescribe courageous movement.

changed_reading.before: Because God can neutralize hostile power, believers may wait for protection.
changed_reading.after: Remembered protection enables believers to cross the required threshold: they act, while entrusting victory and ultimate efficacy to God.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant K-F-Y mapping carried under the focus K-F-F root. It remains anchored in the restraint verb and is reinforced by the focus reliance root's guardian branch, but downstream prose should present it only as an intraradical resonance, never as a replacement translation of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The restraint verb followed by reliance upon God.

activation_trace.role: The split mapping contributes undertaking an affair until sufficiency as a distant resonance within restraint.
The entrusted guardian who preserves and suffices makes the resonance mechanically coherent.

changed_reading.before: God's favor consists only in blocking the hostile hands.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the blocking also resonates as sufficient guardianship: the one entrusted with the affair both restrains the threat and carries protection through.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the negative reciprocal-reliance branch inside the same root as tawakkul. It remains anchored in the focus reliance command and gains a visible enactment from 5:24, but it should be rendered as a warning generated by branch contrast, not as the lexical sense of the focus form.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Let the believers rely upon God.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal reliance that loses the affair supplies the negative edge from which proper trust is distinguished.
Fighting is assigned to other parties, exposing the duty being outsourced.
Sitting out action realizes the loss-producing form of delegation.

changed_reading.before: Reliance means leaving the whole matter to God.
changed_reading.after: Proper tawakkul must be kept distinct from mutual neglect: believers entrust efficacy to God without assigning away their own obligation and sitting.

strongest_changes: Divine restraint becomes an ethical pattern that blocks hate-driven retaliation by the protected community.
Remembering favor becomes covenant maintenance, with forgetting traced toward durable enmity.
Tawakkul becomes active threshold-crossing that entrusts outcome without abandoning duty.
summary.what_was_special: The packet surrounds 5:11 with exact or near-exact recurrences of remembering favor, hostile peoples, taqwa, and reliance, while the repeated hands also join a material sequence of controlled and purified bodily agency.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not identify the historical incident behind the hostile intention, so no event-specific reading is selected.
The hunting, washing, and restrained-hand sequence may be a productive material analogy rather than a deliberate compositional mechanism.
The K-F-Y and reciprocal-reliance outliers are branch resonances and should not be promoted to surface lexical meanings.
